exact_missing_items: Sonnet cleanup priorities: P1 = lock runtime schema anchors (add package/seam/lane/worktree/account identity + contamination/safe-point linkage); P2 = extend Glossary/Crosswalk/Decision_Policy; P3 = rebuild UI contracts around packages/seams/lanes; P4 = consolidate addenda
resolution_kind values: fixed, accepted_risk, superseded, merged, split, invalidated, obsoleted_by_patch, obsoleted_by_recovery
dismissed is not a substitute for resolved
accepted_risk is a resolution, not a dismissal
repeated sightings of the same underlying issue should usually update an existing concern rather than minting endless duplicates
do not merge automatically just because summaries look similar
use source/scope/category/lineage-aware heuristics or explicit governance action
acknowledge: confirmation none; rationale optional; reversibility compensating_action_only via explicit return to active
resolve from a linked canonical fix/recovery/patch outcome: confirmation none or light; rationale optional if the linked record is sufficient; reversibility compensating_action_only via reopened
resolve without linked canonical evidence, including accepted_risk: confirmation strong; rationale required; reversibility compensating_action_only
gap_candidates.blocking_reason: Coverage row indicates incomplete or missing canon alignment for concrete target.
